Experience an unforgettable fusion of India's classical instruments with the mesmerizing sounds of flute, santoor, and sitar, performed by three maestros: Pt. Hariprasad Chaurasia, Pt. Brij Bhushan Kabra, and Pt. Shivkumar Sharma.
Credits:
Song: Pilu
Artist: Pt. Hariprasad Chaurasia, Pt. Brij Bhushan Kabra, Pt. Shivkumar Sharma
Music Director: Rahul Sharma
Lyricist: N/A
Song: Ahir Bhairav
Artist: Pt. Shivkumar Sharma, Pt. Hariprasad Chaurasia, Pt. Brij Bhushan Kabra
